name: quintal
description: A spatial office where your AI agents are visible teammates.

scripts.dev: pnpm --filter @quintal/shared build && concurrently -n shared,server,web -c magenta,cyan,green "pnpm --filter @quintal/shared dev" "pnpm --filter @quintal/server dev" "pnpm --filter @quintal/web dev"
scripts.build: pnpm --filter @quintal/shared build && pnpm --filter @quintal/web build && pnpm --filter @quintal/server build
